macros.name: filemodcmp
macros.doc: This macro compares the file modification date and time of the two given files and expands to the clause of the newest file.

macros.name: filemodnewest
macros.doc: Expands the filename of the newest given file or filename 〈num〉 if both file modification dates are identical.

macros.name: filemodNewest
macros.doc: Expands the filename of the newest given file.

macros.name: Filemodnewest
macros.doc: Stores the newer of the two file names in \filemodresultfile.

macros.name: FilemodNewest
macros.doc: Stores the newest of the given file names in \filemodresultfile.

macros.name: filemodnumdate
macros.doc: Expands to an integer of the form YYYYMMDD which can be used for numeric comparisons like \ifnum.

macros.name: filemodnumtime
macros.doc: Expands to an integer of the form HHmmSS which can be used for numeric comparisons like \ifnum.

macros.name: filemodoldest
macros.doc: Expands the filename of the oldest given file or filename 〈num〉 if both file modification dates are identical.

macros.name: filemodOldest
macros.doc: Expands the filename of the oldest given file.

macros.name: Filemodoldest
macros.doc: Stores the older of the two file names in \filemodresultfile.

macros.name: FilemodOldest
macros.doc: Stores the oldest of the given file names in \filemodresultfile.

macros.name: filemodoptdefault
macros.doc: Holds the default number (i.e. 1) for the optional argument of the previous and following macros.

macros.name: filemodparse
macros.doc: Parses the file modification datetime of the given file and passes the result to the given macro.

macros.name: filemodprint
macros.doc: Prints the file modifications date and time using \filemodparse and \thefilemod.

macros.name: filemodprintdate
macros.doc: Prints the file modifications date using \filemodparse and \thefilemoddate.

macros.name: filemodprinttime
macros.doc: Prints the file modifications time using \filemodparse and \thefilemodtime.

macros.name: Filemodtoday
macros.doc: Prints the file modification date of the given file in the current format of \today.

macros.name: filemodZ
macros.doc: Defined to ‘Z’ with catcode 12 as it is returned as timezone.

macros.name: thefilemod
macros.doc: Reads the date and time as seven arguments and typesets it.

macros.name: thefilemoddate
macros.doc: Receives the date as three arguments YYYY, MM and DD and typesets it.

macros.name: thefilemodtime
macros.doc: Receives the time and timezone as four arguments HH, mm, SS and TZ and typesets it.
